remaining_cautions.finding: MIC matrix values are embedded in Figure 3 image rather than an XML table; rows were manually verified against the local figure image and database rows were used only as a traceability cross-check.

Narrative text line for peptide 58 says S. hominis ATCC 27842, while Figure 3, methods strain list, and linked database rows use S. hominis ATCC 27844; row-level curation follows the Figure 3/methods/database strain label and preserves this caution.
APD6 entry text uses abbreviated/compressed organism ranges and misspells S. hominis in comments; Figure 3 and methods provide the curation labels used in final activity rows.
linked_experiment_records contains a 98-row mirror of linked_assay_records plus seven APD6 entry rows; final audit avoids duplicating mirrored assay rows while retaining row counts and traceability.
Direct mechanism support is from model membrane/liposome/bilayer assays; final curation does not claim a specific intact-cell molecular target or pore stoichiometry in bacteria.
Source-supported pore-forming subset is peptides 615, 623, and 1304; all seven are not promoted to pore-forming peptides.
